## Appearance

Paul Irving is small for his age and possesses exquisite, refined features. He has big, very dark blue eyes, and his head is framed by a halo of naturally curly hair that ranges in color from brown to chestnut.

_Sources: [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P7](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0007), [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P8](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0008), [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P21](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0021), [v2 XV The Beginning of Vacation P11](../source/v02-c15.md#nw-v02-c15-p0011), [v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P7](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0007), [v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P29](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0029), +1 more_

## Personality

A manly, cleanly child and a gentleman, Paul Irving possesses remarkable qualities that set him apart. He is an imaginative genius who also exhibits occasional flashes of uncanny insight.

_Sources: [v2 VII The Pointing of Duty P7](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0007), [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P32](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0032), [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P52](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0052), [v2 XI Facts and Fancies P38](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0038), [v2 XVIII An Adventure on the Tory Road P3](../source/v02-c18.md#nw-v02-c18-p0003), [v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P54](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0054)_

## History

Paul Irving is an imaginative student at the [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) school who lost his mother three years prior. On [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) Shirley's first day of teaching, Paul cheers her up by giving her wild orchids, and he later writes a composition detailing his fantastical adventures with imaginary friends. Over time, he continues to bond with [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), sharing his thoughts about his parents, rock people, and childhood worries, which causes some jealousy in [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md). When news spreads that [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) is resigning her teaching post to attend college, Paul is deeply distressed. During a visit to [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge), Paul connects with Miss [Lavendar](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) over their shared experiences with imaginary dream-people, paving the way for his returning father, [Stephen Irving](../character/stephen-irving.md), to reunite with and marry her. Following the wedding, Paul expresses excitement about moving to [Boston](../codex/places.md#boston).

_Sources: [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P0](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0000), [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P7](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0007), [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P13](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0013), [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P20](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0020), [v2 XI Facts and Fancies P42](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0042), [v2 XI Facts and Fancies P43](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0043), +31 more_

## Quotes

> "and I came back to give them to you because I thought you were the kind of lady that would like them, and because . . ."
>
> — Paul Irving — [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P21](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0021)

> “Yes; but if dryads are foolish they must take the consequences, just as if they were real people,” said Paul gravely. “Do you know what I think about the new moon, teacher? I think it is a little golden boat full of dreams.”
>
> — Paul Irving — [v2 XIX Just a Happy Day P30](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0030)

> "I’ve eaten enough to make anyone grow. I do hope, now that I’ve begun, I’ll keep on till I’m as tall as father. He is six feet, you know, Miss Lavendar."
>
> — Paul Irving — [v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P24](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0024)

> "I think you would make a splendid mother. You have just the right look in your eyes . . . the look my little mother always had. I think it’s a pity you haven’t any boys of your own."
>
> — Paul Irving — [v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P58](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0058)

> "you can’t think what has happened! Something so splendid. Father is here . . . just think of that! Father is here! Come right in. Father, this is my beautiful teacher. You know, father."
>
> — Paul Irving — [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P21](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0021)

## Relationships

### [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne-shirley--paul-irving.md)

Paul is a pupil at [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) Shirley's school, and the two quickly become fast friends. He frequently joins her for walks and shares tea with her, opening up about his imaginative childhood thoughts, worries, and stories about his parents and rock people. Upon learning that she plans to resign from teaching to attend college, Paul is deeply distressed by her upcoming departure.

_Sources: [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P45](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0045), [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P8](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0008), [v2 XV The Beginning of Vacation P0](../source/v02-c15.md#nw-v02-c15-p0000), +10 more_

### [Davy Keith](../character/davy-keith.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/davy-keith--paul-irving.md)
